result:
Only the intended files were touched. Summary of changes:

1. **`backend/app/models.py`** — added `is_verified: bool = False` to `User` (table model) and `UserPublic` (read schema).
2. **`backend/app/api/routes/users.py`** — added `POST /users/{user_id}/verify`, superuser-gated via `Depends(get_current_active_superuser)`, returns `404` if the user doesn't exist, otherwise sets `is_verified = True` and returns the updated `UserPublic`.
3. **`backend/app/alembic/versions/b1c2d3e4f5a6_add_is_verified_to_user.py`** — new migration adding the `is_verified` boolean column (`NOT NULL DEFAULT false`), chained after the current head `fe56fa70289e`.
4. **`backend/tests/api/routes/test_users.py`** — added `test_verify_user_superuser`, `test_verify_user_not_found`, `test_verify_user_without_privileges`, following the existing test patterns exactly (including the `db.refresh()` needed to see the update through a separate session, as done in `test_update_user`).

Verified locally: `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh` passes (mypy, ty, ruff check/format), and the full backend test suite (63 tests, including the 3 new ones) passes against a local Postgres instance after applying the new migration.
